thread:
deploy-bot: [deploy-alert] prod-ml-serving v2.3.1-rc3 canary 5/50: token_mismatch errors exceeded threshold (2.1% over 5m). Automatic traffic halting to rc3.

maria: seeing this on dashboards. Repro steps pointing to recent KV-cache kernel tweak in rc3. Need an expedited hotfix and approval to roll rc2 back or pin rc4 (rc4 contains revert).

kai: can we patch in-place or do a rollback? how risky is rc4?

maria: rc4 is a revert of the kernel-level cache mutation, low risk. Patch would require careful KV invalidation and might take longer. recommend pin to rc4 and rerun canary.

sre_oncall: I can approve for expedited roll. Requesting rollback criteria and a short rollout plan. Will need canary gating and 15m observation windows.

amanda: FYI PMs and CS need a short release note blurb for customers on degraded generations. I can handle the comms once we confirm final action.

maria: approval checklist: 1) eng lead +1 (kai) 2) SRE on-call +1 (sre_oncall) 3) QA smoke pass on canary 4) tag release notes. Security exempt for this change. Proposed rollout: canary 10% (15m) -> 30% (15m) -> 100% if green. Rollback if error_rate > 1.0% sustained for 3m or p95 latency > 800ms.

kai: +1 to pin to rc4 and accelerate. :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: +1. I'll run the rollout gate and watch metrics. I'll set alerting to aggressive for this window.

maria: creating release note snippet and adding it to the changelog: 
```
Hotfix: Revert kernel-level KV cache mutation causing token_mismatch errors in some long-context requests. Impact: degraded text outputs for small subset of requests. Rollout: immediate canary -> full.
```

amanda: copying that to the customer-facing note, will be concise.

ryan: running pin and deploy now. command: `./deployctl rollout --service prod-ml-serving --image v2.3.1-rc4 --strategy canary --canary-percentage 10 --canary-duration 15m`

deploy-bot: Started rollout of prod-ml-serving v2.3.1-rc4. Canary 10%. (initiated by ryan)

sre_oncall: Observing metrics now. Setting canary gate: must keep token_mismatch < 0.5% and p95 latency < 650ms to advance.

[15m later]
deploy-bot: Canary 10% check complete: token_mismatch = 0.11%, p95 = 420ms. Advancing to 30%.

maria: great, continuing. hold on advancing if any regressions.

[15m later]
deploy-bot: Canary 30% complete: token_mismatch = 0.09%, p95 = 415ms. No new errors. Advancing to 100% rollout.

ryan: finalizing full rollout. command: `./deployctl finalize --service prod-ml-serving --version v2.3.1-rc4`

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: prod-ml-serving v2.3.1-rc4 at 100% traffic. All health checks passing.

maria: thanks all — amanda will publish the customer note. I'll open a follow-up ticket to clean up leftover KV artifacts. :eyes:
